description: For an APPROVED agency: add a business to its prospect pipeline, or update its status (to_contact, contacted, interested, invited, joined, not_interested) and a short note. Saving doesn't reserve the business — another agency can still sign it up first. 'Joined' is also set automatically once the business joins through this agency.

note.description: e.g. 'Spoke to the owner, call back Friday'.

name: save_prospect
title: Save or update a prospect in the pipeline
